{{Top|leg}}
The '''Royux Walking Throne''' was a variation on the [[Emperiax Walking Throne]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. The unit removed 150 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of cargo space to add a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. It stood four [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.

With the [[Rise of the Empire era|Rise of the Empire]], the low sales of Royux units encouraged Arakyd to discontinue the line.
